regime_correlation.interpretation: Cross-asset correlation increases monotonically Normal→Crisis (0.40→0.66→0.84), validating the 'cross-section freeze' diversification-collapse pattern in stress regimes.

vol_scale_per_state.rationale: Sharpe-Kelly captures risk-premium; Inv-vol captures naive vol-targeting. Convex blend balances upside in Normal (full scale) with capital preservation in Crisis (~48% scale). Optimizer is free to adopt or override; risk agent reports recommendation only.
